schema.title: Response List Registry Api V1 Registry Get

discriminating_evidence_ids.title: Discriminating Evidence Ids
discriminating_evidence_ids.description: Existing IDs distinguishing the selected cause from alternatives, not merely establishing a symptom. Empty if unavailable.

diagnostic_checks.title: Diagnostic Checks
diagnostic_checks.description: Proposed read-only checks to distinguish causes; never claim they were executed.

source.title: Source
source.description: Provenance hint only. Trusted code derives source from the reference: logs=log; response_body/status_code=response; request_metadata=request; expected_behavior/actual_behavior=user. Never documentation for incident fields.

observation.title: Observation
observation.description: Literal evidence only. Strings: exact nonempty substring. Integers, finite floats, booleans and null: entire canonical JSON scalar text (403, 1.0, true, false, null), no labels, whitespace or paraphrase. Reference scalar leaves, never objects or arrays.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Incident JSON pointer required for extracted observations; only logs, response_body, request_metadata, status_code, expected_behavior, actual_behavior roots are supported. Must resolve to the quoted value.

plan_kind.title: Plan Kind
plan_kind.description: diagnostic means read-only checks; remediation includes configuration changes and requires a supported diagnosis plus human approval.
